senses.definition: (uncountable) The right by law to be the entity which determines who may publish, copy and distribute a piece of writing, music, picture or other work of authorship.
examples: Copyright is a separate legal area from trademarks.

senses.definition: (countable) Such an exclusive right as it pertains to one or more specific works.
examples: The artist lost the copyrights to her songs when she signed the contract.
The images are still copyright of the original artist.
